landing.meta_title: D-HOTEL • The All-in-One Hospitality Management Software
landing.meta_desc: Hospitality PMS, Touch POS for Restaurants & Bars with room charging, digital police registration slips, mobile housekeeping, and direct mobile money payments.
landing.hero_badge: Modern PMS & Touch POS • 0% Commission on Direct Bookings
landing.hero_subtitle: Interactive room rack, Touch POS for restaurant and bar with instant room folio charge, 1-click police registration slips, and Wave & Orange Money payments.
landing.modules_title: Everything your property needs every day
landing.modules_subtitle: From front desk to housekeeping, kitchen to swimming pool, all your operations sync in real time on one unified platform.

gantt.title: Interactive Rack (Gantt PMS)
gantt.desc: Visual drag-and-drop planning for rooms, bungalows, and suites. Instant insight into real-time availability, active stays, and daily arrivals/departures.

pos.title: Touch POS Restaurant, Bar & Pool
pos.desc: High-speed touch point-of-sale for waitstaff and bartenders. Direct, secure 1-click transfer of food & beverage checks onto guest room folios.

police.title: 1-Click Police Slips
police.desc: Strict compliance with Interior Ministry and tourist police regulations. Instant PDF export of the daily guest registry with zero manual handwriting.

housekeeping.title: Mobile Housekeeping & Linen
housekeeping.desc: Dedicated smartphone web app for housekeepers and floor managers: live status updates (Clean, Dirty, Stayover, Inspected & Ready).

daypass.title: Day-Pass & Pool Ticketing
daypass.desc: Management of day passes and pool/beach access for external visitors, with lunch + swim packages and instant Mobile Money checkouts.

mice.title: Conference & Event Spaces (MICE)
mice.desc: Bookings and invoicing for seminar halls, banquets, business meetings, and weddings with coffee-break schedules and AV equipment coordination.

inventory.title: Procurement & F&B Beverage Stock
inventory.desc: Strict tracking of wine cellars, spirits, bottled water, and kitchen staples with recipe sheets, automated stock depletion, and low-level alerts.

night_audit.title: Night Audit & Accounting Export
night_audit.desc: Automated generation of daily manager reports, multi-tender cash drawer balancing (Cash, Wave, OM, Cards), and standardized accounting exports.

landing.demo_title: Experience D-HOTEL right inside your browser
landing.demo_desc: Explore the interactive room rack, simulate a guest check-in, transfer restaurant orders to room charges, and generate departure folios.
landing.pricing_subtitle_suffix: when you choose annual billing. Cancel anytime on monthly plans.
